integrity: The proof is symbolic and unbounded. The 2024 corrigendum was inspected: it corrects Theorem 2.3 and clarifies historical provenance, while the present claim relies only on the definitions and the inequalities corresponding to Theorems 2.1, 2.2, and 2.4. Finite computation is used only as regression evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies equality inputs for three specific inequalities. It does not improve the off-equality bounds or address asymptotic distributions. A residual originality risk remains from older literature using different notation for the modified functions.
title: Exact equality loci for three modified Euler–Dedekind inequalities
